'''Raahan Ma'ase''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] who lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Dor'shan/Legends|Dor'shan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was son of the leader of Dor'shan's largest technology cartel and was a friend of the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], whose family had close ties to Ma'ase's family.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Ma'ase secretly developed the [[XNA-580]], a device that could be used to scramble the brainwaves of most [[Species/Legends|species]]. He attempted to sell the machine to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] via the Separatist sympathizer [[Aviso]].
